_about: RELM in, IRELM out. table defaults to example_table.yaml. options are the relm CLI flags (stateless, strict, locale, *_to_ssml). A case has output or error (an error kind).

cases.name: doc example, stack
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3"> She asked me to buy <MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(0.8)"/><PROSODY s="0.6" v="1.5" p="0.75">roses</PROSODY><MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(None)"/></VAD></IRELM>

cases.name: doc example, stateless
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3"/> She asked me to buy <MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(0.8)"/><PROSODY p="0.75" s="0.6" r="none" v="1.5"/>roses<PROSODY p="none" s="none" r="none" v="none"/><MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(None)"/><VAD v="none" a="none" d="none"/></IRELM>

cases.name: lottery, stateless resolves none to the enclosing value
cases.input: <happy> I won <ecstatic>the lottery</ecstatic> but lost the ticket </happy>
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3"/> I won <VAD v="4" a="5" d="5"/>the lottery<VAD v="4" a="4" d="3"/> but lost the ticket <VAD v="none" a="none" d="none"/></IRELM>

cases.name: lottery, stack
cases.input: <happy> I won <ecstatic>the lottery</ecstatic> but lost the ticket </happy>
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3"> I won <VAD a="5" d="5">the lottery</VAD> but lost the ticket </VAD></IRELM>
